ModMetaData.name: Stored Research Inline ETA
ModMetaData.author: Vorsel
ModMetaData.description:
Appends an estimated research completion time to the final research progress line in the lower-left inspect pane. When Stored Research is active, available stored research points are deducted from the remaining cost.
The feature concept was inspired by Show Research ETA by pureMJ: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3283434105
